community.description: Original patches for Spotify: unlimited skips, ad removal, audio quality forcing, premium spoofing, Canvas and Create button off, and in-app settings.

releases.description:
Add to Reseam Manager
What's Changed
• Bump Gradle+Reseam  -- Correct Workflow by @daedaevibin in https://github.com/kmmiio99o/reseam-patches/pull/2


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kmmiio99o/reseam-patches/compare/v0.0.5...v0.0.7

patches.name: Disable Canvas
patches.description: Stops Canvas video loops from loading and playing in the now-playing view, saving data and battery.

patches.name: Force audio quality
patches.description: Forces the streaming-quality tier the client reads and reports, up to HiFi 24-bit. The bitrate you actually get still depends on your plan and connection.

patches.name: Hide Create button
patches.description: Keeps the Create shortcut button on the Home tab hidden by reporting its setting as off.

patches.name: Premium spoof
patches.description: Makes the client treat the account as Premium: hides the Premium tab in the navigation bar, hides upsell banners, nag screens and free-tier gates like shuffle-only. The server still enforces real entitlements, so downloads and some premium actions may not work.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Keeps ad metadata from being created when a session loads, so ad slots come back empty and no ad audio is prepared.

patches.name: Unlimited skips
patches.description: Removes skip, swipe, and peek restrictions so you can skip freely, including in stations and other restricted mixes.

community.name: vocacolle-reseam-patches
community.author: ilikeadofai
community.description: Patches for VocaColle (jp.nicovideo.nicobox): Korean and English UI, ad and Premium prompt controls

releases.description: • feat: integrate local playlists with VocaColle's native library

patches.name: App name and icon
patches.description:
Changes the launcher name and icon, from the appName and icon options. Changes nothing
without them.

options.title: App name
options.description: The name under the launcher icon. Leave empty to keep ボカコレ.

options.title: Icon folder
options.description: A folder with a square icon.png, or with mipmap-mdpi … mipmap-xxxhdpi folders each holding a square ic_launcher.png (48, 72, 96, 144, and 192 px).

patches.name: Clear caches
patches.description: Adds a button to clear the lyrics, translations, and VocaDB answers the patches keep.

patches.name: Diagnostics
patches.description: Shows why login, guest login, or high-quality audio don't work. Changes nothing.

patches.name: Full rankings
patches.description: Shows up to 300 songs in a ranking instead of the top 100.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description:
Hides launch, banner, list, and audio ads and Premium pop-ups. Each can be turned back on in
the Reseam patches screen.

patches.name: Lyrics from other sources
patches.description:
Shows lyrics from LRCLIB, NetEase, KuGou, or VocaDB when VocaColle has none or hit its
limit, and keeps them for offline songs. Off until you turn it on in the app.

patches.name: My library
patches.description:
Adds favorites, playlists, one-tap offline downloads, watched creators, and saved mylists on
this phone, with buttons on the song page and a row in VocaColle's Settings. Keeps what your
account's limits refuse.

patches.name: Translate songs, tags, and lyrics
patches.description:
Translates song titles, tags, descriptions, notices, and lyrics into Korean or English, with
Google Translate or your own AI key. Off until you turn each part on in the app.

patches.name: Translate UI
patches.description:
Shows VocaColle in Korean or English (the language option). Song titles and anything sent to
the server stay in Japanese.

options.title: Language
options.description: ko for Korean, en for English.

patches.name: VocaDB song titles
patches.description:
Shows VocaDB's English or romanized titles in the player. Off until you turn it on in the
app.

patches.name: YouTube share links
patches.description:
Shares the YouTube original instead of the Niconico link. Off until you turn it on in the
app.
